newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks drop in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks drop in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks dropped in early morning trade on Wednesday, due to a lack of factors to encourage investors to buy, brokers said. They said, however, that the semiconductor book-to-bill ratio released overnight may provide some support for the high-technology sector.
At 0017 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was down 136.25 points or 0.65 percent at 20,902.28. Its December futures were down 80 points at 20,950.

Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities, said buying would be difficult as the listing of JR West on Tuesday had been a neutral factor and it was still difficult to tell which way Japan's general election would go.
The election is scheduled for October 20.
